Elegant 3-Bedroom Villa in Diagon Cluster, Athlon by Aldar

This sophisticated 3-bedroom villa is situated in the highly sought-after Diagon Cluster within Athlon by Aldar, a wellness-focused master community designed for active family living. The home boasts a modern layout with spacious living and dining areas, well-proportioned bedrooms, and premium finishes throughout.

BUA: 2,958 SqFt
Plot Size: 3473.62 SqFt

Perfectly positioned just steps from the community pool, this villa offers convenience and a relaxed lifestyle, ideal for families, end-users, or investors.

Athlon features lush green spaces, walking and cycling tracks, and world-class amenities, all crafted by Aldar, Abu Dhabi’s leading developer.

Handover: Expected 2028
Location Highlights: Close to pool and community amenities
